info.name: Tradeloop API
info.description:
Multi-tenant logistics operations and trucking marketplace API.

**Setup**
1. `docker compose up -d`, `npm run migration:run`, `npm run seed`, `npm run start:dev`.
2. Run a request in **Auth** (e.g. *Login (shipper owner)*). Tokens are saved to collection variables and sent as a Bearer token on every request.
3. Create requests save their ids (`customerId`, `tripId`, ...) so follow-up requests work without copy/paste.

**Seeded accounts** (password = `{{password}}`): admin@tradeloop.local (platform admin), owner@luzonhaulers.local, dispatch@luzonhaulers.local, driver@luzonhaulers.local, owner@visayasfreight.local, driver@visayasfreight.local, owner@metrogoods.local, ops@metrogoods.local.

**Envelope**: success `{ "data": ..., "meta": {...} }`; errors `{ "statusCode", "code", "message", "errors": [{ "field", "messages" }] }`.

**Pagination**: `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 20, max 100), `sort` (endpoint-specific), `order` (ASC|DESC). Optional query params are included but disabled; tick them to use.

Swagger UI: `{{host}}/api/docs` (when SWAGGER_ENABLED=true).

item.name: Marketplace
item.description:
Write **Roles:** OWNER, ADMIN, OPERATIONS_MANAGER, DISPATCHER

Typical flow: carrier publishes truck capacity, shipper publishes a load, either side sends an offer, the other side accepts (creates a booking and assigns the load to the carrier trip).

`visibility`: NETWORK | PARTNERS_ONLY | PRIVATE

From a trip, route/schedule/capacity default from it. Without `tripId`, provide `vehicleId` or `vehicleType`, `originLocationId`, `destinationLocationId`, `departureFrom`, `departureUntil`, `availableWeightKg`, `availableVolumeM3`.

`pricingType`: FIXED | PER_KG | NEGOTIABLE. `publish: false` keeps it as a private DRAFT.
